item.text:
**8B.6 verdict**
Mixed, leaning yes. In 2024 the Trọng system did convert some declarations into real state action: concrete plans, statutory changes, audit standards, and crisis relief with measurable reach. But the anti-graft campaign also produced administrative paralysis and personnel churn, and by mid-July effective personal control had shifted away from Trọng.

**Claim-level evidence**
- **Major tasks and solutions to implement 2024 socio-economic development plan**. Government of Viet Nam. 2024-01-08. [URL](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/major-tasks-and-solutions-to-implement-2024-socio-economic-development-plan-111240108212720274.htm). Claim: the 2024 plan translated rhetoric into concrete priorities on macro stability, inflation control, institutional reform, and budget-linked execution, which is observable policy programming rather than slogan alone. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.2`

- **Law No. 41/2024/QH15 on Social Insurance**. National Assembly / Government of Viet Nam mirror. 2024-07-26. [URL](https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-so-41-2024-qh15-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-119240723163650489.htm). Claim: key old-age support was turned into a state-budget entitlement, showing a move from declaratory welfare language to a legal mechanism with real administrative reach. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.2`

- **Plan for implementing the Social Insurance Law 2024**. Viet Nam Social Security. 2024-11-26. [URL](https://vss.gov.vn/english/news/Pages/vietnam-social-security.aspx?CateID=198&ItemID=12375). Claim: the agency created a steering group, assigned responsibilities, set a national roadmap, and ordered inspection/guidance, which is concrete follow-through inside the bureaucracy. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.5`, `8B.2`, `8B.4`

- **Ban hành mới Hệ thống chuẩn mực kiểm toán nhà nước 2024**. State Audit Office of Viet Nam. 2024-11-27. [URL](https://www.sav.gov.vn/vi/bai-viet/ban-hanh-moi-he-thong-chuan-muc-kiem-toan-nha-nuoc-2024-11-27-14-53-43). Claim: the audit office issued 43 standards tied to professionalism, honesty, objectivity, openness, and transparency, showing institutionalization rather than empty messaging. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.5`, `8B.4`

- **Joint Response Plan: Typhoon Yagi and floods in Viet Nam**. United Nations in Viet Nam. 2024-09-27. [URL](https://vietnam.un.org/en/279852-joint-response-plan-typhoon-yagi-and-floods-viet-nam). Claim: crisis response was organized around named vulnerable groups, cash support, protection, and implementation roles, indicating that state reach extended into real emergency delivery. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.5`

- **UNICEF delivers immediate relief to communities affected by devastating Super Typhoon Yagi**. UNICEF Viet Nam. 2024-09-12. [URL](https://www.unicef.org/vietnam/press-releases/unicef-delivers-immediate-relief-communities-affected-devastating-super-typhoon-yagi). Claim: UNICEF said it worked with the government response to deliver water treatment, sanitation, emergency medical supplies, vaccines, malnutrition treatment, learning spaces, psychosocial support, and cash assistance, which is direct evidence of implementation with observable reach. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.5`

- **IMF staff completes 2024 Article IV mission**. IMF. 2024-06-26. [URL](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/26/pr24239-vietnam-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission). Claim: the IMF credited government actions for recovery from 2023 shocks, with growth near 6 percent and inflation relatively contained, suggesting at least some policy declarations were producing measurable macro outcomes. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.2`

- **Exclusive: Vietnam forfeits billions of dollars in foreign aid amid anti-graft freeze, document says**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-05-17. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/exclusive-vietnam-forfeits-billions-of-dollars-in-foreign-aid-amid-anti-graft-freeze-document-says/2088974/). Claim: Reuters said the anti-corruption drive caused administrative paralysis, delayed approvals, and lost aid, which is strong counterevidence that declarations were being converted into smooth implementation. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.5`, `8B.4`

- **Vietnam removes third top leader in two months, reshuffles cadres**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-05-20. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-removes-third-top-leader-in-two-months-reshuffles-cadres/2092648/). Claim: Reuters described upheaval, infighting, and a chilling effect on bureaucracy, showing that enforcement existed but often damaged administrative execution rather than strengthening it. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.5`, `8B.4`

- **Vietnam's top leader Trong dies at 80, party says**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-07-19. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/vietnams-top-leader-trong-dies-at-80-party-says/2181868/). Claim: Reuters tied the July 18 duty transfer to his illness and death, so any second-half-2024 implementation was only indirectly attributable to Trọng personally. IDs: `8B.6`, also `8B.5`, `8B.4`

**Search gap**
I did not find a single 2024 master audit showing end-to-end implementation across the whole government. The evidence is fragmented across sector plans, legal instruments, audit standards, crisis-response documents, and Reuters reporting on anti-graft bottlenecks. The strongest personal attribution for Trọng drops sharply after the July 18 handoff.
